blind.B1: Yes. Resistance-training study in older adults (abstract): 27 participants, one leg 1 set, contralateral leg 4 sets, 10 wk; biopsies pre and post. All 81 samples (27 baseline, 27 1set, 27 4set per packet A condition column) carry the exercise factor.
blind.B2: Abstract: comparisons by responder group (low/medium/high) for 1-set and 4-set vs pre, and 4 vs 1 set. Responder group sizes are not in the abstract; packet A has no responder field. Pooled n = 27 per condition.
blind.B3: Yes. Each participant has 3 biopsies (baseline, 1-set leg, 4-set leg). Key: 'participant id' / pid, 27 keys each appearing once per condition level, linking 81/81 samples.
blind.B4: Abstract does not say. A joint model with participant blocking is the natural fit.
blind.B5: Not in the abstract (only GO and PLIER pathway results); no DEG counts reported. Full text needed.

checks.evidence: Run; exercise arms in condition field (1set/4set vs Baseline), abstract confirms RT design.

cond BL/S1/S4 = 27/27/27 from the condition field, not the A/BD/BE prefix (BD/BE are randomized legs); no exclusions. Control for S1/S4 is the participant's own baseline. Responder stratification not reconstructable (no GEO field), recorded as a declared deviation.
Contrasts ordered treatment vs control: S1 vs BL, S4 vs BL, S4 vs S1 (control S1).
Formula ~ subject + cond with subject='P_<pid>' as a string category; full rank, residual df 52; matches candidate key (27 keys, once per level).
Paper silent in abstract; joint model on all 81 samples is the defensible default. Per-sex fits are labelled exploratory.
Leg side randomized to volume; sex inferred from X/Y and fitted per subject (within-subject so aliased only through subject). No batch field. Recorded.
Integers 100%, STAR+featureCounts raw counts; DESeq2 Wald. n_tested varies (3201-42884) across contrasts, consistent with DESeq2 independent filtering when few genes are rejected; deg_sanity ok.
Paper rule not stated in abstract; padj<0.05 without FC cutoff recorded as workflow_default and a declared deviation.
paper_counts empty, no counts compared. HANDBACK explicitly says comparison rests on the abstract; FZD1 mRNA check is flagged as only indicative.
No stop or refusal in this case.

summary: 本案例通过审查：81个样本为27名受试者各3次活检（基线、1组腿、4组腿），模型以受试者为区组（~ subject + cond），分组、方向、配对均与摘要和GEO元数据一致。论文阈值、DEG数量和响应者分组在摘要中缺失，已作为声明偏离记录，未做过度的论文对比声明。
